description: Save a TOP to an image file at its native, full resolution (PNG/JPG/EXR/TIFF by extension) — for exporting a finished frame, unlike get_preview which only transfers a small inline thumbnail. The file is written by TouchDesigner on the TD machine; pass an absolute path.

file.description: Output file path (written by TouchDesigner, so on the TD machine). Extension picks the format: .png/.jpg/.exr/.tiff. Use an absolute path.

node_path.description: Path of the TOP to render to a file.

name: render_output
title: Render output to file
